title: Dose thresholds, progression and alcohol metabolism
guide: 1 peg = 60 ml 40%; male 40–80 g (2 pegs), female 20–40 g (1 peg), 5 days/week × 15 years; alcoholic hepatitis mortality 70%, CDT best marker; 3–5 years to reversible fatty liver → cirrhosis (micro → macronodular, nucleus to periphery, HCC risk) or alcoholic hepatitis (binge); enzymes ALDH, CYP2E1, catalase; acetaldehyde toxic; ALDH polymorphism poor metaboliser prone to hepatitis.

title: HESST injury, histology images, laboratory and clinical features
guide: Hypoxia zone 3 mitochondria, ER stress Mallory hyaline, superoxide via CYP2E1, ↓SAM/↑SAH → TNF-α (pentoxifylline), acetaldehyde ↑NADH → ↓glutathione → leaky gut; fat >5% hepatocytes; neutrophilia, enzymes 300–500, AST:ALT >2:1 likely / >3:1 highly suggestive, albumin not significant, ↑PT/INR, ↑MCV, thiamine blocks pyruvate→acyl-CoA and transketolase; jaundice, soft painful abdomen, hepatomegaly.

title: Histopathology, complications, prognostic scores and treatment
guide: Zone III fatty infiltration; ballooning/alcoholic hyaline with PMN infiltrate; HCV steatosis note; nodules with fibrous septation; fulminant → encephalopathy + coagulopathy → ↑ICT → death; DF = 4.6 × (PT pt − control) + bilirubin ≥ 32, MELD ≥ 18, Glasgow ≥ 9; steroid 1 mg/kg × 7 days taper 3 weeks; unfit: sepsis, renal failure, GI disease → pentoxifylline 400 mg TDS × 4 weeks.

title: Miscellaneous notes: cirrhosis morphology, steatosis mnemonic, Reye's, nutmeg, Mallory–Denk
guide: NASH m/c cause of cirrhosis; micronodular list (alcohol, biliary, ICC, CF, Budd-Chiari, hemochromatosis) vs macronodular Wilson's; 'Pretty visits Jamaica with Alcohol and Acid' microvesicular vs HCV/NASH/Wilson's macrovesicular; Reye's swollen fewer mitochondria; nutmeg = chronic venous; Mallory-Denk ER-stress eosinophilic inclusions seen in Wilson's, ICC, NASH, cholestasis, alcohol/A1AT, PBC, HCC, not HBV/HCV.
